source: R. H. Bow, Economics of Construction in relation to Framed Structures, London: Spon, 1873, Part I, tables of roof trusses (pp. 17-30) and framed bridges (pp. 31-40); each design redrawn as an exact construction from the printed drawing
units: nodes in spans (support to support = 1, z up); span in mm; radii (half square sections) in mm
sizing: span: Bow's where stated, else sub-spans x 8 ft; roof 1.5 kN/m2, deck 5 kN/m2, trusses 3 m apart, x 1.4; frame analysis with rigid joints; square GL24h sections, N/A + M/W within design strength, buckling of struts; one section per chord
